NOW THEREFORE BE it enacted by the Parliament of the
Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka as follows:—

1.
This  Act  may  be  cited  as  the  Ceylon  German
Technical  Training  Institute  Act,  No.      of  2017  and  shall
come into operation on such date as the Minister may appoint
by Order published in the Gazette  (hereinafter referred to as
the “appointed date”).
PART I
ESTABLISHMENT OF THE CEYLON GERMAN TECHNICAL TRAINING
INSTITUTE

2.
(1) There shall be established, an institute which shall
be called the Ceylon German Technical Training Institute
(hereinafter referred to as “the Institute”).
(2)  The  Institute  shall  by  the  name  assigned  to  it  by
subsection (1), be a body corporate with perpetual succession
and a common seal and may sue and be sued in that name.

3.
(1) The Ceylon German Technical Training Institute
established by a Resolution of the Ceylon Transport Board
(hereinafter referred to as “CGTTI”) approved and adopted
by the Board of Directors of the Ceylon Transport Board,
shall hereby stand  transferred to the Institute established by
section 2.
